_doc.enabled: Master switch. Set false to silence all guardrails without uninstalling.
_doc.disabledChecks: Rule ids to skip entirely (e.g. ['nplus1-heuristic'] if too noisy for this project).
_doc.strictChecks: Rule ids that BLOCK (exit 2) instead of advise. Only ids with strictEligible:true are honored.
_doc.maxFileBytes: Skip files larger than this — keep the hook cheap.
_doc.escapeHatch: Add `// jbt:ignore <rule-id>` on any line to suppress one rule for that file, or `// jbt:ignore-all` to skip the file.
